$ yg check --aspect nope
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error: Unknown aspect 'nope'.
--aspect drills into ONE rule by its aspect id, but 'nope' is not an aspect defined in this graph — so the filter would match nothing and render a misleading "0 of N errors" view. Known aspect ids: no-todo.
Run: yg aspects (list every aspect id), then yg check --aspect <id> with a real id; or yg check (full wall).
